title: Bandcamp Friday Conversion Rate
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:bandcamp campaign_day=* purchased=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(purchased="yes",1,0))) as matched by campaign_day
| eval a_purchase_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_purchase_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Bandcamp visits that end with a purchase by campaign day.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which campaign day are helping or hurting Bandcamp visits.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a purchase` on `music:bandcamp` events and summarize the hit rate by `campaign_day`.
visualization: Table of campaign day with percentage of Bandcamp visits ending with a purchase.
grandmaExplanation: It records how often a purchase happens for each campaign day so you can see where Bandcamp visits go smoothly or get stuck.
